name: Afton Scientific
event_blurb:
Afton Scientific provides aseptic fill-finish services for sterile injectable products, supporting both biologic and small molecule formulations across vials, syringes, and cartridges. Our capabilities span clinical through commercial manufacturing, giving partners a single, reliable source from early-phase development through full-scale production.
Core services include sterile filling, inspection, and packaging, backed by an in-house analytical and microbiology laboratory that supports method development, testing, and release activities without reliance on third-party labs. This integrated lab footprint allows for tighter quality control, faster turnaround, and closer collaboration between manufacturing and testing teams throughout a program's lifecycle.

name: Aspen API
event_blurb:
For companies sourcing generic commercial APIs and / or advancing with new molecule APIs through Phase IIb and Phase III, Aspen API offers the ideal balance of development expertise, manufacturing excellence, and commercial readiness. We are specialized in HP-APIs, Peptides and Steroids, either by tech transfers or own development.
As a mid-sized partner, we provide direct access to experts and full customer attention—without the complexity often associated with larger suppliers. Our proven capabilities in complex APIs, scalable and sustainable manufacturing, regulatory support and reliable supply help de-risk development and accelerate the path to commercialization.
Aspen API: the responsive partner that combines scientific expertise, manufacturing reliability, and dedicated customer focus to bring your product successfully from late-stage development to market.

name: Boehringer Ingelheim BioXcellence™
event_blurb: At Boehringer Ingelheim BioXcellence™, we specialize in biologics contract manufacturing, producing biopharmaceuticals based on microorganisms as well as mammalian cell cultures. In collaboration with our partners, we manufacture innovative therapies for some of the world’s most challenging diseases. We have extensive experience with a variety of different host cells, producing a broad range of molecules in accordance with cGMP manufacturing guidelines and covering all stages of development, including aseptic filling. Our focus is on creating value for our customers through robust processes, optimal preparation for launch, and global clinical and commercial supplies of high-quality biopharmaceuticals.

name: Honour Lab
event_blurb:
Honour is a global CDMO supporting pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies from early development through commercial manufacturing. With eight cGMP-compliant manufacturing facilities, over 5,000 KL of manufacturing capacity, and a team of 3,500+ employees including approximately 300 scientists, Honour provides integrated capabilities across process development, analytical development, scale-up, technology transfer, and GMP manufacturing.
Our expertise spans small molecule APIs, complex chemistries, peptides, oligonucleotides, custom amidites, modified nucleosides, and related advanced modalities. We support partners with challenging chemistry capabilities, flexible development models, and global regulatory experience to accelerate programs from discovery through commercialization.

name: Kaneka Americas Holding
event_blurb:
Kaneka is a Japanese technology-driven chemical company offering custom synthesis services from its Health Care Business Unit positioned as a specialist CDMO partner.
We focus on small molecule chemistry with over 40 years of experience in process development, scale-up and manufacturing of Regulatory Starting Materials, GMP intermediates and APIs and support the entire drug lifecycle.
From our 4 research centers and 4 manufacturing sites in Japan and Singapore, we offer a full range of custom synthesis services based on our core technology platforms of chemical syntheses, biocatalytic transformations and flow chemistry ensuring safe, robust and sustainable processes.

name: Mikart, LLC
event_blurb:
Mikart’s 50 years of experience as a CDMO in oral solid and nonsterile oral liquid dosage forms and specialization in pediatric, geriatric, and controlled-substance make us the ideal contract development and manufacturing organization partner — from formulation development through commercialization. We value long-lasting relationships and a personalized approach; bringing both the reliability and flexibility to meet your needs and exceed your expectations.
Mikart’s ability to scale proof of concept dosage forms through to commercialization has benefitted our clients with product line extensions in a multitude of delivery systems.

event_blurb: With a focus on ophthalmic, otic, and topical products, Ophtapharm is proud to be an FDA-approved facility offering contract manufacturing services to customers in North America, Europe, and beyond. name: Ropack, Inc.
event_blurb: Ropack Pharma Solutions is a leading contract manufacturing and packaging organization based in Montreal, Quebec. With nearly 50 years of experience, Ropack specializes in solid oral dose formats for pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and food products serving markets including North America, Western Europe and beyond. Our services include manufacturing, packaging, and clinical trial support across all phases of the drug development process. With four state-of-the-art facilities, Ropack is trusted by top organizations in the industry as we continuously innovate to tackle our partners biggest challenges helping bring key products to market.

name: Sharp
event_blurb: Sharp helps biopharma companies bring therapies to life from pre-clinical development to commercial launch and beyond. As a specialist CDMO, we deliver commercial packaging, clinical trial, and sterile manufacturing solutions designed to reduce complexity. With facilities in the US, UK, Belgium, and the Netherlands, and a global network of 30 clinical depots, we extend your reach to your patients. Backed by 70+ years of experience and continued investment in facilities, capabilities, and people, we offer quality by design, engineering know-how that scales, and the precision and reliability our customers can lean on.

name: Wilmington PharmaTech
event_blurb: Better API Science. Reliable American Supply. Wilmington PharmaTech (WPT) is a U.S.-based contract research, development, and manufacturing organization (CRDMO) specializing in small molecule and high-potency API development and cGMP manufacturing. Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Newark, Delaware, WPT provides end-to-end services from discovery through commercial supply, including custom synthesis, process development, scale-up, and analytical testing for pharmaceutical and biotech companies.
